//: DRAFT (Step 16 slice 1): the layout is a first pass; the id and the door ids are permanent. One screen wide, about two and a half tall. In from the ridge at the foot (column 0, rows 26-28); one-way ledges two tiles apart zigzag up (each overlaps the next over columns 8-11, so jumping on the spot there climbs them, every body alike) to the top floor (row 5). At the top the east opening goes on to the depot (column 19, rows 2-4) and a hidden opening in the west wall (column 0, rows 2-4, painted as wall here) comes out on the ridge's shelf. A body that falls lands on the ledges or the floor; nothing kills.
name: The Tower
